qs.s: Le tribunal l'a condamné à trois ans de ___.
qs.en: The court sentenced him to three years in prison.

qs.en: The walls of his cell were cold and covered with dampness.

qs.en: He gazed at the starry sky through the small window of his cell.

qs.en: He was locked up in a high-security prison.

qs.en: The general commanded a powerful army of a hundred thousand men.

qs.en: The country mobilized its army to respond to the enemy threat.

qs.s: Il s'est engagé dans l'___ de terre plutôt que dans la marine.

qs.en: The government decided to raise the tax on the income (earnings) of the wealthiest households.

qs.s: Il perçoit ___ revenu minimum garanti par l'État.
qs.en: He receives a minimum guaranteed income from the state.
